g.text: Does PSI add value beyond subgrouping?
Paired complete streams; both methods use the same groups and a 5% horizon budget. Percentile bootstrap intervals use 5,000 paired resamples.
Positive favors PSI; negative favors KS. Degenerate intervals at identical paired outcomes do not prove population equality.
